translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content.text: Ex quelemtac ab'ec, yujto tzex avtaji yic tzeyic' e jelanil, yic sq'uib' pax e pensar.
Yaln̈ej b'aj ayex eq'ui, d'a junoc tzalan, ma d'a yol b'e, ma b'aj schalaj sb'a b'e, tzex avtaji.
An̈ejtona' d'a spuertail e chon̈ab', tzex avtajpaxi.
E masanil ex anima ayex d'a yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic, ab'ec.
Ex quelemtac to mantalaj e pensar, c'ayb'ejec e b'a d'a jelanil. Ex chuc e pensar, sayec jelan pensaril.
Ab'ec val sic'lab'il, ol alchaj juntzan̈ tastac nivac yelc'och d'ayex, man̈xo jantacoc svach'il.
Te yel tas ol alchaj d'ayex, malaj tas ton̈ej ol nachajq'ueoc.
Masanil juntzan̈ lolonel tic vach'n̈ej, malaj jab'oc es d'ay.
A eb' jelan, secojtac tz'aj snachajel juntzan̈ lolonel tic yuj eb'. A eb' ay spensar yojtac eb' tas syalelc'ochi.
Aq'uec eyip eyic'an e jelanil yed' aj pensaril, yujto yelxo val te nivan yelc'och d'a yichan̈ q'uen oro yed' q'uen plata.
Yelxo val te vach' jelanil d'a yichan̈ q'uen q'ueen te vach' yilji yed' d'a yichan̈ junoc tas snib'aj val ochi.
A jelanil, yetb'eyum sb'a yed' vach' pensaril. Syac' cojtaquejel juntzan̈ vach' razonal.
Tato ay yelc'och Jehová d'ayon̈, sco chaccanel chucal. Tato jelan on̈, max yal-laj quic'anchaan̈ co b'a. Max co nib'ejochlaj chuc b'eyb'al yed' es.
Tato ay co jelanil, syal co naan junoc tas sco c'ulej d'a stojolal, tz'eln̈ejpaxc'ochi.
A yuj jelanil syac' yajalil eb' rey, tojol syutej eb' sch'olb'itan tastac yaj eb' yetanimail.
Yuj jelanil chi', a eb' ayoch yajalil, vach' syutej eb' stan̈van schon̈ab', vach' pax syutej eb' sb'oan yaj yoval eb' anima.
A mach sayanec' jelanil yed' smasanil sc'ool, tz'ilchaj yuuj.
Yuj jelanil chi', tz'aj co b'eyumal, tzon̈ b'inaj yuuj, ay pax quelc'ochi.
A tas tz'ilchaj yuj jelanil chi', yelxo te vach' d'a yichan̈ q'uen oro yed' q'uen plata sic'b'ileli.
Yuj jelanil, sco b'eyb'alej vach'ilal yed' tojolal.
A mach snib'an jelanil, ol yic' sb'eyumal yuuj. Ol b'ud'joc spat yuj masanil tastac vach'.
A jelanil chi', aytaxoneq'ui ayic ix el yich smunlajel Jehová, ayic manto sb'o masanil tastac,
ayic manto sb'o yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic,
ayic mantalaj a' nivac mar, mantalaj pax sjaj a' nivac a' sq'ueuli yed' pax sjaj a' cotac a'.
Ayic manto sb'olaj lum tzalquixtac yed' lum nivac vitz, ayxoec' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ix yic'canel yich jelanil Jehová ayic manto sb'olaj lum luum tic, mantalaj spococal jun yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic ta'.
Ayic ix sb'oanq'ue satchaan̈ masanto b'aj schalaj sb'a yed' a' mar, aytaxon ec' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ayic ix sb'oan asun ay d'a satchaan̈ yed' pax yic ix syamanoch vaan a' mar,
ayic ix yalan d'a a' mar chi' to man̈ ol el a' b'aj aycani yed' pax ix yac'anem yich lum luum tic, aytaxon ec' jelanil chi' ta'.
A yuj sjelanil Dios ix sb'oq'ue masanil tastac, ste tzalaj yuj tastac ix sb'o chi', yujto a' sch'oxanel sjelanil.
Stzalaj yuj yolyib'an̈q'uinal yed' eb' anima sb'onac.
Axo ticnaic ex anima, ab'ec val tas tz'alchaj d'ayex, b'eyb'alejec jelanil yic te vach' eyico'.
Chaec eyab' e c'ayb'ub'al, man̈ e patiquejel jelanil.
Te vach' yic mach scham val yab'an lolonel yic jelanil,
yujto a mach tz'ilchaj jelanil chi' yuuj, tz'ilchajpax sq'uinal, syic'anpax svach'c'olal Jehová.
Palta a mach max chaan yab' lolonel yic jelanil, munil syic'cot yaelal d'a yib'an̈.
